scope: Proposition 4.6 (Common relations with controlled coefficients) of the manuscript “Quaternionic division points on curves in the Siegel threefold” (preprints/Quaternionic-Division-Points-on-Curves-in-the-Siegel-Threefold-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 016 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e11b4b068502ced9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose h ≥ Q0(d), increasing Q0 if necessary. The proximity embeddings can be partitioned into at most Q1(d) groups, and one group V has Ssmall = X v∈V wv log(1/|a|v) ≥ h/Q2(d). (4.9) On each group there is one fixed list of analytic equations, evaluated at one algebraic tuple (a, U), of one of the following forms: ⟨B, Y (a)P⟩ = T, with T ∈ M2(Q), (4.10) ⟨B, Y (a)P⟩ = B′ , Y ′ (aR)P′ , R = b/a, b = x′ (t′ ), (4.11) together with the actual branch equations z − z(a) = 0, z′ − z′ (aR) = 0 when a second chart is present. (4.12) The primed data are one simultaneous field conjugate of the complete labeled unprimed data. In (4.11) all places are finite and |R|v = 1 on the group. The Frobenius of the common reduction transports each of the two labeled pairs to its primed pair. The tuple has degree at most Q3(d) over K, and h(a, U) ≤ Q3(d)h, X v∈V wv log max(1, ∥U∥v) ≤ Q3(d)(1 + log h). (4.13) Writing the common list as E(a, U) = P j≥0 ajej(U), it has fixed length and deg ej ≤ C(1 + j) (j ≥ 0), h(affine coefficient tuple of (e0, . . . , el)) ≤ Q4(l, d)(1 + log h) (l ≥ 0). (4.14) There are bv ≥ 0 with X j≥l aj ej(U) v ≤ |a|l v exp (1 + l)bv  (l ≥ 0), (4.15) X v∈V wvbv ≤ Q5(d)(1 + log2 h). (4.16) The series are formed from fixed ordinary-point algebraic connection systems in a and aR, and fixed algebraic chart series, by polynomial operations of fixed degree.
